# Product Requirements Document: KubePulse Telemetry Console

## 1. Overview
KubePulse is an operational command center and real-time telemetry console for site reliability engineers and distributed systems architects managing large Kubernetes clusters.

## 2. Target Audience
- Principal Site Reliability Engineers (SREs)
- Infrastructure engineers and DevOps operators
- Power users operating with keyboard-first navigation and terminal workflows

## 3. Product Character & Personality
- Tactical, high-density, mission-critical, lightning fast.
- Feels like an advanced flight cockpit HUD or cyberpunk telemetry terminal.
- Strict dark mode environment for low eye strain during 12-hour incident response rotations.

## 4. Key Workflows
- Real-time streaming log anomaly detection
- Pod crash loop visualization and network topology graphs
- Hotkey-driven cluster switching and shell execution
- Tabular latency and error budget tracking

## 5. Visual Constraints
- Monospaced typography for tabular metrics, coordinates, and log timestamps.
- Zero unnecessary whitespace that compromises data density.
- Tactical status badges and HUD coordinate frames.
